AC AMENDMENTS (plan-review F1, F2, F5 + gap-analysis):

**gh CLI unavailability (plan-review F1 critical)**: Add test cases for fail-CLOSED behavior:
- Given 'gh' not in PATH → assert_worktree_removable exits non-zero with GUARD_PR_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: gh CLI not installed
- Given 'gh auth status' returns non-zero → assert_worktree_removable exits non-zero with GUARD_PR_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: gh not authenticated
- Given 'gh' returns HTTP 403 (rate-limit) → assert_worktree_removable exits non-zero with GUARD_PR_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: rate-limited
- Sanctioned override: WORKTREE_REMOVAL_SKIP_PR_CHECK=1 + WORKTREE_REMOVAL_SKIP_PR_CHECK_REASON=<text>; both required for bypass; single var insufficient.

**Sub-PR enumeration (plan-review F2 major)**: Tier 1 (gh pr list --head <session>) finds MAIN PR ONLY. Sub-PRs have head=story/<epic>/<story>, NOT the session branch. Required enumeration:
- Source A: gh pr list --head <session-branch> --state open (main session\xe2\x86\x92main PR)
- Source B: gh pr list --base <session-branch> --state open (ALL sub-PRs whose BASE is the session branch \xe2\x80\x94 includes story/* sub-PRs)
- Source C: 3-tier fallback (commits/<sha>/pulls + gh pr list --search) applied to BOTH session-branch and any sub-branches discovered in Source B for completeness
- Union all results, dedup by PR number.

Add test case: 'two PRs in flight — main session\xe2\x86\x92main + sub-PR story/X/Y\xe2\x86\x92session/abc' — assert BOTH PR URLs appear in refusal message.

**Worktree-path quoting (gap-analysis #5)**: Add test cases for worktree paths containing:
- a space ('worktree with space')
- a unicode character ('caf\xc3\xa9-worktree')
- a leading dash ('-startsWithDash')
Each must be correctly handled without word-splitting, glob-expansion, or flag-confusion.

**gh mock pattern (plan-review F5 minor)**: PATH override (create $TMPDIR/bin/gh as executable stub, prepend to PATH) — NOT bash function override. Function overrides don't propagate to subprocesses; the library spawns gh as a subprocess.

Additional AC items:
- [ ] Test covers gh unavailability fail-closed (all 3 modes)
  Verify: grep -cE 'PATH unset|gh auth status.*fail|rate.limit' tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh | awk '{exit ($1>=2?0:1)}'
- [ ] Test covers sub-PR enumeration via --base (not just --head)
  Verify: grep -qE 'gh pr list --base|--base <session' tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh
- [ ] Test covers special-char worktree paths
  Verify: grep -qE 'space|caf|unicode|leading.dash' tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh
- [ ] Test uses PATH override (not bash function) for gh mock
  Verify: grep -qE 'mktemp.*bin|PATH=.*bin|chmod +x.*gh' tests/scripts/test-worktree-removal-guards.sh
